name: Cluster caltrops
community_notes: [APPROX] The rule grants one re-roll per model equipped with cluster caltrops; the per-model re-roll count is not expressible, so it is modeled as a re-roll of the Eviscerating Fly-by wound dice (subset all-failures per the codebase re-roll convention). Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Pain Engine (Aura)
community_notes: [APPROX] add 1 to the roll if no model in this unit has a spirit vortex; Pain tokens spent for reasons other than Empowering do not trigger this ability

name: Experimental Enhancements
community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21. Gated on token-count-at-or-above (a spend requires holding a Pain token) and capped at once per fight phase via the resource-spend cap; the cap is a community reading of the once-per-activation structure.

name: Shadowfield
community_notes: fragile invuln: lost on a failed save (engine reads the 4+; the breaking mechanic is not modelled)

name: Precognisant
community_notes: [APPROX] After both players deploy, up to three DRUKHARI units are redeployed; the rule additionally lets those units be set up in Strategic Reserves regardless of the reserve limit, which is not modeled by the redeploy move. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Agonising Suppression
community_notes: Requires spending 1 Pain token to Empower this model; the suppression then triggers after it shoots.

name: Incubi Shrine Token
community_notes: Once per battle, change one Hit or Wound roll to an unmodified 6. Modeled as 1 guaranteed crit hit per activation.

name: Power From Pain
community_notes: [APPROX] spend Pain tokens to Empower a unit until the end of the phase, activating all its Pain abilities; an Empowered Attached unit activates its Leader and Bodyguard Pain abilities together

name: Towering Arrogance
community_notes: ARCHON-only enhancement. While the bearer leads a unit, models in that unit improve Leadership by 1 (modeled as a -1 to the Leadership characteristic) and Objective Control by 1.

name: Combat Drugs
community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of your Command phase you either deliberately select one drug (cannot pick the same one twice per battle) or randomly select two by rolling 2D6; the once-per-battle-per-drug limit and the random-two alternative are not modeled (stance-select mode re-selectable). All options buff WYCH CULT models/weapons; 'improve' for Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill and Leadership is modeled as a subtraction from the characteristic. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Murderous Agenda
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the Trophy Hunters Contract: at the start of the first battle round one enemy CHARACTER is designated the Contract unit, and KABAL / BLADES FOR HIRE attacks against it gain [PRECISION]. The two other Contracts (Sow Fear and Terror → [SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs INFANTRY/MOUNTED; Show of Strength → [LETHAL HITS] vs MONSTER/VEHICLE), the KABAL/BLADES-FOR-HIRE attacker restriction, and the +3 Pain tokens gained when the Contract unit is destroyed are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Rain of Cruelty
community_notes: Each time a DRUKHARI unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn its ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER] and its melee weapons gain [LANCE].

name: Callous Competition
community_notes: [APPROX] DRUKHARI units start the battle winning the wager; each time a DRUKHARI unit destroys an enemy unit DRUKHARI units are winning and HARLEQUINS units are losing, and vice versa when a HARLEQUINS unit destroys an enemy unit
